title: USS Enterprise (CV-6) — Battle of Midway Station Duty

enterprise_action_report.title: USS Enterprise (CV-6) Action Report — Battle of Midway Island, June 4–6, 1942
enterprise_action_report.notes: Used for Enterprise-specific message traffic, ship operating context, attack-group composition, radar/lookout contact reporting, and the ship's role as TF 16 flagship. Times in the original report use its stated zone convention; this build does not silently replace the v0.3 canonical Midway clock with them.

nhhc_enterprise.title: USS Enterprise (CV-6)
nhhc_enterprise.notes: Used for ship identity, Yorktown-class context, displacement description, and Enterprise's Midway role.

nhhc_midway.title: Battle of Midway
nhhc_midway.notes: Used for TF 16 context, the 4 June battle sequence, and Enterprise flight-deck imagery/caption data including VT-6 preparation and the fourteen TBDs launched from Enterprise.

nhhc_strategic_analysis.title: Battle of Midway: Strategic and Tactical Analysis
nhhc_strategic_analysis.notes: Used for TF 16 operating context, launch-cycle analysis, and the documented change to course 240° true and 25 knots after launching operations.

BRIDGE.name: Bridge
BRIDGE.mission: Steer the carrier, maintain formation discipline, and provide safe wind-over-deck conditions for aviation.

CIC.name: Combat Information Center
CIC.mission: Correlate radar, lookout, scouting, and command-net reports without creating false certainty.

RADIO.name: Radio Central
RADIO.mission: Receive, classify, route, acknowledge, and preserve critical operational traffic.

ENGINEERING.name: Engineering
ENGINEERING.mission: Maintain propulsion, electrical generation, fuel discipline, and readiness for rapid maneuvering.

DAMAGE_CONTROL.name: Damage Control Central
DAMAGE_CONTROL.mission: Set material readiness, stage repair parties, preserve watertight integrity, and prepare for casualties.

FIRE_CONTROL.name: Fire Control / Air Defense
FIRE_CONTROL.mission: Maintain air-defense readiness, classify tracks, coordinate lookouts/radar, and avoid wasteful engagement decisions.

AIR_OPS.name: Aviation Operations
AIR_OPS.mission: Coordinate spotting, fueling, arming, launch/recovery cycles, CAP reserve, and flight-deck safety.

initial_tasks.title: Set battle damage-control readiness
initial_tasks.detail: Stage repair parties, verify watertight boundaries, and place Damage Control Central at battle readiness before the air action intensifies.

initial_tasks.title: Open priority command circuits
initial_tasks.detail: Establish the priority routing watch so scouting and command-net traffic can be acknowledged and forwarded without unnecessary delay.

initial_tasks.title: Prepare flight deck for combat cycle
initial_tasks.detail: Bring spotting, fueling, arming, deck crews, and CAP reserve to launch-ready condition without sacrificing deck safety.

initial_tasks.title: Bring plant to maneuvering readiness
initial_tasks.detail: Prepare propulsion and electrical generation for rapid carrier maneuvering and sustained flight operations.

notes: Historical event timing is inherited from the v0.3 Midway scenario package.
Enterprise-specific source notes are layered on top without silently reconciling differing time-zone conventions across historical documents.
Bridge wind-over-deck, engineering readiness, station readiness, crew proficiency/fatigue, and deck-readiness percentages are simulation variables rather than archival measurements.
